override_rules.precedence: project file with same id replaces catalog entry
override_rules.invariant: hard stages from the org catalog may not be removed or softened by project overrides or conversational deviation
override_rules.conversational_overrides: permitted for hard:false stages; every applied deviation is recorded on the work item with approver and rationale

workflows.title: New Feature Development
workflows.trigger: New feature, enhancement, or user-facing behavior change
workflows.chain: product-owner(requirements*) -> architect(design) -> quality(test-definition*) -> software-engineer(implement*) -> quality(code-review*+human) -> security(security-review^) -> devops(release-readiness*)

workflows.title: Product Research & Prioritization
workflows.trigger: A product requirement or problem needs investigation, idea generation, and prioritization before committing to build

workflows.title: Bug Fix
workflows.trigger: A defect: existing behavior deviates from documented or expected behavior

workflows.title: Security Bug
workflows.trigger: A vulnerability or suspected security defect - confirmed or reported

workflows.title: Structural Refactor
workflows.trigger: Structural change with no intended behavior change: module reorganization, pattern migration, debt paydown, domain extraction

workflows.title: Constitution Amendment
workflows.trigger: A law needs to be created, modified, or repealed - any change to the constitution's laws

legend.^: conditionally hard - escalates to hard when the diff touches the gating laws' surfaces
